instruction.thesis: The BTC put-call exhaustion / reversal thesis (H-069 promoted) required a P/C ratio spike above 1.0 during consolidation as the trigger. The btc_ibit_pc_ratio has since normalized from the spike (0.74 at entry context) back to 0.701, and BTC spot has drifted -0.48% from entry at $76,989 to $76,618. The spot is now at the 13th percentile of its 24h range and 2nd percentile of its 7d range — the consolidation is not holding above entry. With only 62h remaining before expiry and the position at -0.48% against a -1.5% stop, the thesis of a P/C-driven bounce has not materialized. The btc_spot trajectory shows a consistent drift lower over the last 12 snapshots (77,010 → 76,618) with no reversal signal. Closing to preserve capital before the stop is hit.
